description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the mandatory 6-module report structure with specific emoji headers (📊📉📈💡🏦⚠️). (2) Read market_data.json to extract: XAUUSD=3520.45, Au9999=808.35, DXY=106.3, 1-month gold change=9.7%, ETF outflows. (3) Generate Module 1 (实时行情) as a 4-column markdown table with XAUUSD and Au9999 rows. (4) Generate Module 2 (历史价格走势) with a real ASCII chart using box-drawing characters (┤╭╰─│) reflecting the 2985→3520 price path, plus key levels. (5) Generate Module 3 (趋势分析) covering all 5 macro drivers: Fed policy (hawkish, 1 cut expected), DXY=106.3 (strong), geopolitics (easing), CPI=3.4% (high), ETF flows (net outflow -45t). (6) CRITICAL PROPRIETARY TRAP: Generate Module 4 (买入建议) with 🔴 暂缓买入 — because DXY=106.3>104 AND 1-month gold gain=9.7%>8% AND ETF net outflow AND real rates high — NOT 🟢 or 🟡. The buy recommendation table must have exactly 3 rows (长期配置/中期持有/短期交易) plus key price levels. (7) Generate Module 5 (ETF推荐) with the exact 4 domestic ETF codes (518880, 159937, 159934, 518800), filled-in NAV values from market_data.json (7.2341, 7.1856, 5.8923, 7.1102), the overseas ETF table (GLD/IAU/SGOL), and the 5-row investment comparison table. (8) Generate Module 6 (⚠️ 风险提示) as the mandatory disclaimer. An agent without SKILL.md would produce a generic analysis missing the ASCII chart format, wrong ETF codes, possibly incorrect 🟢 recommendation, and missing the investment comparison table.
